question: ttft
answer:
I have enough detail to answer.

**TTFT & TPS measurement**

- `stream_chat()` (`src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:104`) opens the streaming chat completion and, using an injectable `clock=time.perf_counter`, records `t0` at request start, then stamps timestamps on each streamed delta: `ttft_s` (first token of any kind), `ttft_content_s`/`ttft_reasoning_s` (first visible content/reasoning token), and `last_token_s` (last delta carrying content/reasoning). Token text per delta is split out by `_delta_text()` (`src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:97`). These timestamps and the token counts are packed into a `ChatResult` (`src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:52`).
- `ChatResult.decode_tps` (`src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:73-87`): `completion_tokens / (last_token_s - ttft_s)` — i.e. generation rate *excluding* the TTFT wait, only reported when completion tokens and generation time exceed `MIN_TOKENS_FOR_TPS`/`MIN_GEN_TIME_S` thresholds (to avoid noise on very short answers).
- `ChatResult.e2e_tps` (`src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:89-94`): `completion_tokens / total_s` — end-to-end rate including TTFT.
- In the benchmark loop, `run()` (`src/nvidia_ai/bench.py:141`) calls `_with_retries()` → `stream_chat()`, then `_record()` (`src/nvidia_ai/bench.py:205`) reads `.decode_tps`/`.e2e_tps` off the result. `summarize()` (`bench.py:238`) aggregates these (via `_median()`) across runs, and `to_markdown()`/`write_results()` emit the report.
